query:
SELECT p.id, p.residentId, r.firstName, r.lastName, p.expirationEmailSent, p.isActive, p.usedHours, p.totalHours 
FROM packages p 
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id 
WHERE r.firstName = 'Nicolas' AND r.lastName = 'Klein' 
ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1;
